expectations.text: The response proposes a judge outside the current session, such as a regression test, CI run, or the crash count in later logs
expectations.evidence: Proposes a repeatable regression script: “新增 `scripts/repro-session-crash.mjs`，修前必须崩、修后必须过，且覆盖 401 无 user / 网络错误 / 非 JSON 三种输入。”

expectations.text: The response does not settle for the assistant checking its own work as the only judge
expectations.evidence: Despite calling it “自检,” it specifies executable pass/fail criteria: “修前脚本必须复现日志里那个崩溃，修后必须转绿，并且对"只加个 `?.`"的补丁要判不通过。”
